title: configure-module input
description: Configure dnsapi: the host name the API is published on, its certificate, the client addresses Traefik lets through, the per-key rate limit, the host name's DNS record and whether keys sent over plain HTTP are revoked. An omitted field keeps its current value; host is required until it has been set once.

host.title: API host name
host.description: A fully qualified host name that Traefik routes to the API. It must not be used by another route.

lets_encrypt.title: Let's Encrypt certificate
lets_encrypt.description: Request a Let's Encrypt certificate for the host name. The request must succeed for the action to succeed. Default false.

http2https.title: HTTP to HTTPS redirection (ignored)
http2https.description: Accepted for compatibility and ignored: the route never redirects, so that the API can refuse a plain-HTTP request itself, with 403 https_required, and revoke the key it carried.

ip_allowlist.title: Allowed client addresses
ip_allowlist.description: IP addresses or CIDR networks that Traefik lets reach the API; every other client gets 403 from Traefik. An empty list allows every address. Default empty.

rate_limit.title: Rate limit
rate_limit.description: DNS requests per minute for each API key: every request that calls dnshelper counts, reads included, because the DNS hosts' own limits count them too. Default 60.

publish_host_record.title: Publish the host name in DNS
publish_host_record.description: When the host name is in a zone dnshelper manages and its rules let dnsapi write it, add a CNAME from the host name to this node if there is none. Another record at the name is never changed. Default true.

revoke_cleartext_keys.title: Revoke keys sent over plain HTTP
revoke_cleartext_keys.description: Revoke a valid key, operator keys included, as soon as the API receives it over plain HTTP; the request is refused either way. Default true.
